team.title: Coverage

lookHere.strong: Lower than the city by more than chance (n {n})
lookHere.about: Look here: an area is flagged when, over the last 4 weeks, its notched share is lower than the rest of the city's by more than chance explains, even after allowing for looking at all the areas at once. At most 3 are shown, in no order.

about.p1: Of the street-dog bites where the patient could tell, this is the share where the dog had the right-ear V-notch, the mark of a sterilised dog.
about.p2: The notch is a stand-in. It tells us what patients saw on the dog that bit them, not how many street dogs are sterilised.
about.p3: The claimed band fits what we see only if sterilised and unsterilised dogs bite equally often. They may not.
about.bounds: If every could-not-see bite were notched, the share would be {high}. If none were, {low}.
about.interval: The interval shows how far chance alone could move the figure.

areas.title: Areas
areas.about: Analysis areas: groups of neighbouring wards made for this study. They are not Jammu Municipal Corporation zones.

map.pickNone: Ward {no} {name} is in no analysis area.
